image_description: A low-angle, medium-shot photograph of a large radio telescope facility. The image features a massive white parabolic dish antenna mounted on a complex steel truss structure. In the foreground and to the left, there are red steel support towers and a conical white housing structure. At the base, there is a small utility building with windows and a fenced perimeter. The sky is clear blue.
